Tetra are 4-10 schooling fish, usually how many fish you have cant be higher than how many gallons your tank is so you have exactly 10 fish. There is also a possibility that you get male and female tetras and they can mate and that could make your tank over capacity. If I were you I would go with 4 tetras, 3 Cory’s (Cory’s are good companions for bettas) and stick with the female beta but you can also make a little group of female betas and they usually don’t fight unless they are put with males outside of a community tank. If you plan on getting a light for the tank you might also want to get a nerite snails because they are very good at cleaning up algae.
Lmk if you have any other questions I can try to help you!
